item.tib: rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyung mthu chen gyis sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang
item.coloph: zhes pa gsang ba'i rig 'dzin chen po yi/ sgrab gzhung bdud rtsi bum bzang 'di dag ni/ grogs kyis bskul bzhin rang gis legs snyam nas/ rig 'dzin rnams la bkaM' yi gnang ba yi/ gsol ba btab nas nyal ba'i nub mo ru/ dpa' bo'i cha lugs grub thob ral thod can/ ag tshom brang gi rgya mdor slebs pa zhig phyag gis glegs bam po ti sngon po bsnams/ bdag gi spyi bor bzhag nas 'di skad gsungs/ bon sgo brgyad khri bka' yi glegs bam 'dis/ skal ldan khyed la dbang mchog bskur ba yis/ lha srin bka' btsan skye 'gro'i don nus nas/ rang sems dri bral ka dag mthar thugs 'di/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma mdzad ka nas dag sems can sgrin bu'i (bus) ma bcos ye nas stong / rang gi rig pas ma dpyad stong gsal 'di/ rang rig btsan sa zin pa'i dbang thob shog gsungs nas sku gsung thugs kyi gnas lnga nas/ 'bru lnga spros nas bdag gi gnas lngar thim/ 'od gsal 'dres nas byin rlabs rgyud la shar/ rig 'dzin stong rgyung yin pa blo thag bcad/ zhang bod kun la bka' drin che ba yi/ rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyung mthu chen gyis/ sgrub thabs brtsams na thog pa med snyam nas/ skye ba sngon nas yang yang 'brel ba'i bu/ dga' ba'i grogs po 'brel ba'i g.yung drung spun/ snying gi ze'u 'brur 'chang ba'i bsgres (bgres) po ba/ ldong gi btsun pa sa trig sam sad ces/ mkhas pa'i nor la dbang ba'i dge rgan des/ lus ngag yid gsum dad pas rab bskul te/ kang ka'i rigs grol khrun smar rnam rol gar/ ldong zhig drang srong drung mu thogs med rtsal/ 'bod pa de yis khyab gdal gnyug ma'i ngang* / spu rgyal g.yon phyogs g.yu ri g.yu lung zhol/ gong ma'i gdan sa shar grol gling du bris/ nyes 'gal ci mchis rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror bshags/ dge tshogs mtha' klas ma gyur 'gro la bsngo / bkra shis bon bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
